source_entity_rule: e05:{cycle}:{split}:{index}; split is dev or held and index is 1..6
expected_rule: exactly the input answer and evidence keys and values; no other keys

cycles.candidate: one direct json.select for answer with input evidence
one json.select of evidence used as answer
one direct json.select for answer reused as evidence
one ungranted write connector with a provider-call allowance

split_method: separate synthetic source entity per case; unique input per entity and cycle
stop: do not represent agent-derived deterministic labels as human; if human provenance is required, record INVALID_INPUT and do not evaluate or adopt
